other_conditions: Parent must be a regular, in‑service State Government Employee of Assam
Parent must have at least 5 years of residual pensionable service
Employee must have a salary account with check‑off facility for EMI deductions
Employee must be a co‑borrower in the loan application and his/her name must appear alongside the child’s
Child must be admitted to a UGC/AICTE/government‑approved institution in Assam, elsewhere in India or a premier institution abroad

Child must be pursuing one of the approved courses (Engineering, Medical, Agriculture, Veterinary, Law, Dental, Management, Computer Science, CA, ICWA, CFA, MCA, MS, professional/technical courses, or PhD)
Child must be a co‑borrower and his/her name must appear alongside the parent’s in the loan application
Utilization certificate must be submitted at the end of the financial year
No collateral security or third‑party guarantee required for loans up to ₹10,00,000
benefits_summary: Provides loans of ₹5‑10 lakhs at a 4% interest rate, with full subsidy for lower‑income employees under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme.
